description: This file defines the ISiloLifecycle interface, which represents the observable lifecycle of a silo in Orleans. It includes properties to track the highest completed startup stage and the lowest completed stopping stage.

classes.name: ISiloLifecycle
classes.description: An interface representing the observable lifecycle of a silo, including properties for lifecycle stage tracking.

methods.name: HighestCompletedStage
methods.description: Property indicating the highest lifecycle stage that has completed starting.

methods.name: LowestStoppedStage
methods.description: Property indicating the lowest lifecycle stage that has completed stopping.
